in_arabic.name: Kabeesha
in_arabic.long_meaning: Kabeesha هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'kabasah', which means 'to be small' or 'little one'. In Islamic tradition, the name Kabeesha carries a symbolic meaning of humility and obedience to Allah.
